name: Save, edit, reload and delete a private script
description: A signed-in owner can save and edit a script, retains it after refresh and can delete it; anonymous visitors cannot read the workspace.
steps: Sign in with the supported test account if required. Open Videostudio and choose Nytt manus.
Click Spara manus with empty title and script; verify validation and no new saved project.
Set title to QA Original and script to Why does everything begin with a question? An idea grows when we explore it together. The next step is trying something small. Save the script.
Change title to QA Edited and save. Refresh the page, open Videostudio, select QA Edited and verify the saved script.
Exportera text and verify a text file downloads.
Delete QA Edited using its Radera action, confirm and refresh. Verify it is absent.
Log out. Verify the sign-in page displays and private projects are no longer visible.
expected: Validation rejects empty content; saved edits survive reload, text export downloads, confirmed deletion persists and sign-out hides all workspace data.

name: Import real source signals with pause and resume
description: The implemented intelligence role gates source collection and actual HN API data appears with provenance.
steps: Sign in and open AI-agenter. Pause Global Trend Intelligence if not already paused.
Refresh and verify its state is Pausad.
Open Trendradar and click Hämta Hacker News. Verify the paused-agent error is shown without simulated results.
Return to AI-agenter and resume Global Trend Intelligence. In Trendradar fetch Hacker News.
Verify actual signal titles, Hacker News labels, HN-poäng, source link and observation timestamp.
Search for a unique nonexistent phrase and verify the empty result. Clear search and verify signals return. Set source filter to Hacker News.
Refresh and verify the imported signals persist.
expected: Pause persists and blocks collection; resumed collection produces source-backed records with timestamps, filtering works and data survives refresh.

name: Generate one real AI draft and render downloadable MP4
description: A capped explicitly approved AI draft can be edited and exported as an actual silent vertical MP4.
steps: Sign in. On Översikt choose Använd sociala trender + English if not already saved. In Inställningar enable Aktivera manuell AI-provning and save.
In Trendradar fetch Hacker News, choose one signal and click AI-manus. Accept the explicit credit-cost confirmation.

Wait for a real generated script in Videostudio. Verify both its original title and four paragraphs are in English, with a saved source URL. The source title may be another language. No unsupported source-video or cross-platform claims should be made.
If the output is longer than 180 words shorten it to four short paragraphs and save.
Click Skapa MP4 and wait for encoding to complete. Verify the actual video player, 1080 × 1920 and 15–45 second technical summary and no-audio disclosure.
Play the video, tick the manual review checkbox and download the MP4.
Change the manuscript and verify the previous rendered video and review check are invalidated.
expected: Actual AI text is persisted and the generated MP4 plays and downloads with verified dimensions/duration; text changes invalidate its preview and review.

name: Source failures and unconnected publishing remain honest
description: An injected collection failure is visible and disconnected social providers never pretend to publish or report metrics.

body_json.error: Datakällan svarade inte. Försök igen senare.

steps: Sign in. Open Trendradar and click Hämta Hacker News.
Verify the collection error is visible and no fabricated new source data is added.
Open Anslutningar and check YouTube is Ej ansluten when no key is configured, while TikTok and Meta remain unconnected.
Open Publicering and verify no active schedules or Auto-mode activation exists; manual MP4 export is the available path.
Open Analys & tillväxt and verify missing performance metrics are shown as unavailable, not invented statistics.
expected: The error is actionable; no fake source records, publications or analytics appear, and missing integrations are labelled accurately.

name: Mobile settings validation and persistence
covers: per-account English profile selection and region
description: A mobile user can set and retain valid preferences while invalid budgets are rejected.
steps: Sign in on mobile. On Översikt choose Använd sociala trender + English if not already active. Verify the saved profile badge, then navigate horizontally to Inställningar.
Set daily production budget to 10 and monthly budget to 5. Save and verify validation error.
Change monthly budget to 100, max videos to 2 and YouTube-region to Sverige. Verify Manusspråk is English. Keep manual AI trial off, leave publishing stop checked. Save.

Reload and open Inställningar; verify all saved values and English output. Existing projects remain intact, including older non-English drafts. The profile button preserves all existing budget, region and consent values.
Verify disclosure that production budgets are saved but automatic paid production is blocked and manual AI trial costs are separate.
Open AI-agenter through mobile navigation and verify the ten roles are accessible without horizontal page overflow.

Using another signed-in account with Svenska selected, open or reload its workspace without choosing the profile button. Verify it remains Svenska; only an explicit settings save changes that account.
expected: Invalid budgets are rejected; valid settings persist and mobile controls remain usable with clear limits.

name: Background collection with stop, cancellation and durable results
description: An authenticated user can enqueue, stop, resume, cancel and execute source-only work with persistent outcomes.
steps: Sign in, open Bakgrundsjobb, ensure the queue is resumed and choose Samla källsignaler with Hacker News.
Create a job and refresh. Verify the job remains queued or has a real completed result.
Stop the queue, verify Kör nu is unavailable and the stopped state survives a refresh. Resume the queue.
For a waiting source job choose Kör nu; verify completion and source records in Trendradar. Returning to the job page must show the completed record without a second Kör nu button.
Create another source job with a start time tomorrow, cancel it, refresh and verify it remains Avbruten with no run action.
Verify another signed-in user's queue does not display these jobs.
expected: Job state, control state and cancellation persist; execution produces genuine source data and terminal jobs cannot be re-run.

name: Scheduled pipeline consent and missing configuration guard
description: The queue validates consent and dates and never claims an unobserved scheduler heartbeat.
steps: Sign in and open Bakgrundsjobb on mobile. Choose Samla signaler och skapa ett AI-manus.
Leave AI consent unchecked and attempt to enqueue. Verify an explicit validation error and no created job.
Select a start date more than seven days away. With a source-only workflow attempt to enqueue and verify date validation.
Verify YouTube cannot be selected without a configured API key.
Verify server status shows a real timestamp or Inväntar körning rather than invented activity.
expected: Missing consent, invalid scheduling and unavailable integrations are blocked; mobile form and provenance remain clear.

name: Use YouTube as the social trend source without claiming full coverage
description: Configured YouTube collection appears as the primary source while unconnected platforms remain explicit.
steps: Sign in with the configured YouTube integration. Open Översikt and choose Hämta YouTube-signaler.
Verify Trendradar displays actual YouTube records, source links and observation timestamps; source filter is YouTube.
Verify the coverage notice describes a limited popularity sample and marks TikTok, Instagram and Facebook unconnected.
Switch to Alla källor, then fetch Hacker News and verify the filter switches to Hacker News. Switch back to YouTube and verify its imported records remain after refresh.
expected: Real YouTube observations remain available, source filtering works and broad creative scope never implies unconnected platform coverage.
